Profile AST-120 is an adsorbent consisting of spherical microcrystalline carbonaceous particles with oxygen complex including surface oxides. It is given orally to delay the progression of chronic renal failure by removing uraemic toxins and their precursors from the gastrointestinal tract. It is also under investigation in gastrointes- tinal disorders. ◊ References. 1. Takahashi N, et al.
